description: Source code for the ExecutorRunnable class in Spark's YARN resource manager integration, responsible for launching and managing executor containers on YARN.

classes.name: ExecutorRunnable
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of a Spark executor container on YARN, including container startup, environment setup, command preparation, and service data configuration.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Initializes the NMClient and starts the executor container.

methods.name: launchContextDebugInfo
methods.description: Generates debug information about the executor launch context, including environment variables, commands, and resources.

methods.name: startContainer
methods.description: Creates and starts the YARN container with the prepared context, environment, tokens, and commands.

methods.name: configureServiceData
methods.description: Configures service data for shuffle service recovery and authentication.

methods.name: prepareCommand
methods.description: Prepares the command line to launch the executor, including JVM options and Spark-specific arguments.

methods.name: prepareEnvironment
methods.description: Sets up the environment variables for the executor container.
